quotes.text: It doesn't come up with new ideas. It is an insanely powerful research tool. It can get you to the right answers really quickly.
Most people want a salary. It's stability, it's predictability, it's an ability to take work and have it in a defined expectation box.
A boring $40 million warehouse project has hundreds of contracts. Having a thoughtful, documented SOP for that is highly unusual, if not impossible.
